A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

SIC-POVm’s are a special case of a more general class of covariant POVMs, which can be described in terms of Galois orbits in a certain space of polynomials, and which have a number theoretic interpretation in terms of the ring of integers of a certain number field.
the SIC-POVMS are the only covariant POVMs whose moment polytope has a non-trivial Galois orbit.
the Galois orbit of the SIC-POVMS are the images of moment maps of the orbits of a cyclic Galois orbit in the maximal torus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SIC equations can be understood in terms of the geometry of the moment map.
the Galois orbits of SICs are related to a special class of Galois orbits in the moment polytopes.
the SIC equations are intimately related to number theory and that the number of SICs is related to the Galois group of the number field.
